_doc: Editable inputs for projections. Every value carries its source. Values marked 'estimate' or 'assumption' are NOT measurements: once a real pilot (cost/pilot_runs.json) or a refresh (cost/refreshes/*.json) exists, measured per-unit costs, latencies and fallback rates replace them automatically and the report says which was used. Prices live in cost/rates.csv.

full_run.source: GRADING_CONTRACT.md / course brief; distinct-text count verified by reading the full CSV on 2026-10-10

declared_scope.decided_by: project owner (declared subset; the full corpus is projected for reference only, not run)

controls._max_workers_doc: enrichment workers of the final run: both invocations that made enrichment calls in runs/final-200k-v2 ran 16 workers (runs/final-200k-v2/invocations/*.json, recorded in cost/refreshes/final_200k_v2.json); the later memo regenerations used 4 and made no enrichment calls. Chosen after 1 -> 2 -> 8 worker steps; at 16 the Flex tier returned 1 HTTP 429 and 16 timeouts in the final run (172 HTTP 429 in the superseded run), all retried, far below the configured 1,000 RPM limit (see report.md, 'Scaling decision')
controls._crosscheck_fraction_doc: share of distinct texts cross-checked by the OpenAI Decisions API (hybrid backend). 0: production uses backend=llm because the Decisions beta allows this account 50 requests/day (measured: x-ratelimit-limit-requests 50, refill 28m48s per request, runs/probe-decisions); measured Decisions input 1,812-2,018 tokens/request, no cached tokens
controls._output_token_cap_per_review_doc: enrich.llm.max_output_tokens_per_review: 200 at effort low (reasoning tokens count as output); 70 in the superseded effort-none run
controls._max_fallback1_fraction_doc: enrich.fallback1.max_fraction of the final setup (label_config cfg-52c5333247); the superseded effort-none run used 0.10

base._note: with measured inputs, base adds no retries on top of the measured ones and uses measured fallback rates

conservative._note: fallbacks at their caps, 15% extra attempts, 30% more tokens per unit

failed_attempt_billing: Measured costs use reported usage; failed attempts without usage cost $0 unless the call timed out (reservation kept as unknown).

local_compute.note: All model inference here is remote API inference; local compute is only the orchestrating laptop.
